body:
INSTAGRAM
The one rule for every AI automation: AI drafts, a human decides. Here's when to remove the human.

Fully automatic sounds great until one weird reply goes to a customer.
Let the AI do 90% of the work. Spend 10 seconds checking it.
Keep a human on anything you can't take back: money, customers, legal, hiring, public posts.
Make approving one tap: send the draft to Slack, Telegram or email, approve, log it.

Got a boring task? Comment it below and I might automate it in the next episode.
Small business? DM me AUDIT.

The one rule I follow for every AI automation: AI drafts, a human decides.
